name: io.github.smaniches/semantic-scholar-mcp
title: Semantic Scholar MCP Server
description: MCP server providing access to 200M+ academic papers via the Semantic Scholar API. Supports paper search, author profiles, citation graphs, AI-powered recommendations, and bulk retrieval. Handles DOI, ArXiv, PubMed, ACL, and Semantic Scholar IDs.
